entries.label: resist cold

entries.label: ghoul

entries.snippet: "You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.savage-incarnation]{Savage Incarnation}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory.",
entries.label: Savage Incarnation

entries.label: Feral Incarnation

entries.snippet: "You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.incarnation-of-harmony]{Incarnation of Harmony}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory."
entries.label: Incarnation of Harmony

entries.snippet: "You can activate this ability on your turn to make the @Ref[dragonbane-core:rule.dash]{dash} action a free action during that turn."
entries.label: dash

entries.snippet: "A strike with a two-handed ranged weapon inflicts D8 additional points of damage, but you cannot move in the same round. You can activate this ability after the roll to hit, but not if you moved. This can be combined with @Ref[dragonbane-c
entries.label: Twin Shot

entries.snippet: "You know the @Ref[dragonbane-core:spell.sense-magic]{Sense Magic} magic trick and can cast it without spending WP. Whenever you roll for LANGUAGES, you can choose the result 10 instead of rolling."
entries.label: Sense Magic

entries.snippet: "The damage of your unarmed attacks increases to D10. If you use @Ref[dragonbane-core:heroic-ability.iron-fist]{Iron Fist}, the damage increases to 2D10 for that unarmed attack. You can also parry both melee and ranged attacks unarmed. When
entries.label: Iron Fist

entries.snippet: "You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.shadowform]{Shadowform}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory."
entries.label: Shadowform

entries.snippet: "Whenever you deal @Ref[dragonbane-core:rule.sneak-attack]{sneak attack} damage to a target, the dice increase for damage is increased by two dice instead of one (for example, 3D8 instead of 2D8 for a weapon that deals D8 damage)."
entries.label: sneak attack

entries.snippet: "When you hit with a piercing or slashing weapon, you can activate this ability to also apply one dose of @Ref[dragonbane-core:journal-page.combat-damage.poison]{poison} that you are carrying, as if it was ingested by the target. You can ac
entries.label: poison

entries.snippet: "You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.elemental-totem]{Elemental Totem}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory.",
entries.label: Elemental Totem

entries.snippet: "When you use @Ref[dragonbane-core:rule.power-from-the-body]{Power from the Body}, you get to keep any excess WP you do not use when casting the spell, up to your maximum WP."
entries.label: Power from the Body

entries.snippet: "You can wield a two-handed melee weapon in one hand. This can be combined with @Ref[dragonbane-core:heroic-ability.dual-wield]{Dual Wield}."
entries.label: Dual Wield

entries.snippet: "Instead of making a @Ref[dragonbane-core:rule.death]{Death Roll} you can activate this ability to automatically succeed as if you had rolled a dragon."
